The suit has been filed by the plaintiff against the defendants seeking permanent injunction restraining the defendants or anybody acting under them from infringing registered Trademark design Nos.274667 and 274668 with respect to the marketing of packaged chocolates in a box with a specific arrangement and for a permanent injunction restraining the defendants from passing off their products, namely, chocolates as if they are the products of the plaintiff using the same design in the packing of the chocolates and also for damages at Rs.50,000/- and for costs of the suit.
2. The case of the Plaintiff is that they are the proprietorship concern, which is carrying on the business in the name and style of M/s.Vaibhav Foods represented by its proprietrix Ms.Anusha.
The second Defendant is also the proprietorship concern and the first defendant is the proprietor of the second defendant.

The Plaintiff is the one of the largest distributors of chocolates and they are delivering excellent quality of chocolates by using high quality ingredients and by adopting modern manufacturing methods to enhance the taste of their product.

It is further stated that by excellent quality, unique presentation style http://www.judis.nic.in of the chocolates and with a commitment to deliver the chocolates at reasonable price, they have earned prestigious fame and reputation with M/S.Vaibhav Foods vs Narendra Kumar Mali on 17 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74213790/
2 the mark "KOKOLEKA" .
3. The Plaintiff submits that he is the creator of this unique style of "Arrangement of Chocolates design" together with colour combination and this specific design being new and original has gained enormous amount of goodwill in trade and consumers.

sentences.text: The said design was originally adopted by the Plaintiff in the year 2015 in respect of different varieties of chocolates and has been continuously, uninterruptedly and extensively using this specific arrangement of chocolates design packaging (hereinafter the 'Said Design') in relation to its product as mentioned above.

Further,the Plaintiff had applied for the registration of this unique arrangement of chocolates with specific colour combination design under Design Application Nos.274667 and 274668 on 19.08.2015 and the Certificate of Registration of Design was issued on 22.11.2017 by the Controller of Patents and Designs, Kolkatta and the same was marked as Ex.P1.

The Plaintiff is also the registered dealer under Karnataka Value Added Tax Act, 2003 with a Tax Payers Identification Number (TIN)-29501271116 and they were also http://www.judis.nic.in registered with Food Safety and Standard Authority of India (FSSAI) having License No.1121533000934 and the same were marked as Exs.P2 and Ex.P3 respectively.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The VAT Audit Report of the Plaintiff was marked as Ex.P7.
It is further stated that the Plaintiff is having registration under GST having registration number as 29BBIPA1062Q1ZF and the GST Registration Certificate is marked as Ex.P4.

The Plaintiff also has ISO 220000:2005 certification for Manufacturing and Packaging of Chocolates and Dry Foods,
having Certificate No.17DFAM88, which was marked as Ex.P5.
Further the Plaintiff is an Income Tax Assessee.
To prove the same, the income tax returns for the Assessment Year 2016-2017 was marked as Ex.P8 and its acknowledgement was marked as Ex.P11 and the Pan card of the Plaintiff is marked as Ex.P6.

The Statement of Accounts Certificate issued by the Chartered Accountant was marked as Ex.P10.
4.

It is further stated that, since its launch the specific design of arrangement of chocolates (hereinafter referred as the "Said Design") has gained popularity in the Indian market because of enormous design amd by virtue of long, continuous and extensive use from the year 2015, the plaintiff has captured its own market http://www.judis.nic.in among the public with this specific design of arrangement of chocolates.
The said design plays a pivotal role in the growth of Plaintiff since 2015.

The images of the different varieties of Plaintiff's product was marked as Ex.P9.
5.

While this being the position, it came to the knowledge of the Plaintiff that the Defendant has been doing business of manufacturing and selling of chocolates specifically arranged in a unique design including the Design of the chocolate package box (set) which is similar and identical to the unique arrangement and shape of the said Design of the Plaintiff.

It is further stated that the first defendant is manufacturing and selling chocolates through the second defendant in a manner which is similar to the Plaintiff's unique design arrangement and decoration of chocolates in Chennai and also in various other cities in India, adopting the unique design, as that of the Plaintiff's registered Design, thus leading to deceptive similarity, confusion and deception and violating the Plaintiff's adopted and registered design and arrangement.

It is also further stated that the arrangement of chocolates has been done with unique feature enabling the consumer to count the number of chocolates apart from giving http://www.judis.nic.in container for the maximum visual impact.

The Defendants packaging is also identical transparent plastic container with the label affixed in the M/S.Vaibhav Foods vs Narendra Kumar Mali on 17 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74213790/
3 centre.

sentences.text: The first defendant is involved in the business of manufacturing of chocolates in a specific design arrangement and distributes the same through the second defendant under their registered brand name "Only queen" under application no.3046804 which is a slavish imitation of the Plaintiff's design and style of package of the Plaintiff.
Hence, the Plaitniff is contrained to send the Cease and Desist notice dated 11.08.2017 to the defendants, which was marked as Ex.21.
The defendants sent a reply dated 04.09.2017 denying the same, which was marked as Ex.P22.

In the said reply, it was stated that they are opposing the registration of the Plaintiff's design application no.274667 and 274668 in class 09-03 in respect of design of packaging with chocolates (set), before the controller of Patents, which was marked as Ex.P12.

Further, the VAT Registration Certificate of the Manufacturer, FSSAI Certificate of the manufacturer, PAN Card of the Manufacturer, Aadhar card of the manufacturer, Entrepreneurs Memorandum acknowledgement of the Manufacturer issued by the Government of Karnataka, Directorate of Industries and Commerce, Trade License Certificate of the Manufacturer, GST-Certificate of http://www.judis.nic.in Provisional Registration of the Manufacturer and Trade License Renewal acknowledgement of the Manufacturer are marked as Ex.P13 to Ex.20 respectively, to prove the case of the Plaintiff.

It is further stated that even after receipt of the said legal notice, the first defendant continues to manufacture and sell chocolates by adopting the design and package that is similar and identical to the registered design of the Plaintiff.
It is further stated that the use of identical & deceptively similar design by the defendants are causing irreparable loss and hardship to the Plaintiff.
In such circumstances, the present suit has been filed for the aforesaid relief.

6. Though summons have been served on all the defendants, there was no representation on their behalf, when the matter was called and therefore, the defendants were set exparte on 11.06.2019 and the matter was posted before the learned Additional Master for recording exparte evidence.

7. In order to substantiate its claim, one Ms.Anusha, sole proprietrix of the plaintiff firm was examined as P.W.1. and filed certain documents, which were marked as Ex.P1. to Ex.P.23, as http://www.judis.nic.in discussed above.

8. On perusal of the pleadings, evidence and documents available on record, this Court found that the defendant has been doing business of manufacturing and selling of chocolates specifically arranged in a unique design including the design of the chocolate package box (set) which is similar and identical to the unique arrangement and shape of the said design of the plaintiff.
The Plaintiff has registered its design and the certificate of design also issued on 22.11.2017 by the Controller of Patents and Designs, Kolkotta.
Therefore, the plaintiff has proved its claim and entitled for the reliefs as sought for.
9. Resultantly, the suit is decreed as prayed for with costs.
